title: Side-panel detail view with inline edits
description: Detail side panel (beads-web style, not full page) for issues and epics: title, description, design, acceptance criteria, notes, comments, dependencies. Inline editing of status, priority, assignee, labels via bd update. Epic detail shows child issues in an inline table at the bottom (no separate tab). Mutations optimistically update then refetch.

title: Projects view: epics table with expandable child issues
description: Linear projects-style view listing epics: status grouping, priority sort, progress % from epic_closed_children/epic_total_children, issue counts. Each epic row expands inline to show its child issues (parent-child deps / bd list --parent) — the drill-in Linear doesn't do. Row click opens side panel.

title: Issues view: Linear-style table/list with grouping and sorting
description: TanStack Table issues view. Grouping by status, label, project (epic); sorting by priority and status; filtering by status/type/label/assignee. Linear-style collapsed group headers with counts. Display columns: ID, status icon, title, labels, epic, priority, updated. Row click opens side panel.

title: Scaffold TanStack Start app
description: Create the TanStack Start project: Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Biome, zod. Mise for tasks/env. Memorable dev port. Verify dev server boots and a hello route renders.
close_reason: TanStack Start scaffolded at repo root: port 8345, shadcn (14 components), Tailwind v4 neutral theme, Biome clean, vitest green with dedicated config (nitro plugin excluded to avoid teardown hang), SSR verified via nitro build. Routes /projects, /issues placeholders.

title: bd data layer: server functions wrapping the bd CLI
description: Server-side module that shells out to bd with --json and parses output through zod schemas. Reads: list (with filters), show (incl. dependencies/comments), stats. Writes: update status/priority/assignee/labels, close, create. Config for which beads project dir to target (env or config file). Epic-children query via bd list --parent <id>. Unit + integration tests against a throwaway bd database.

title: pm-beads v1: Linear-style web UI for beads
description: A local, lightweight Linear-style web UI on top of the beads (bd) issue tracker. Greenfield TanStack Start app (decided over forking beads-web, which is 28K LOC of Next.js + Rust/Axum whose UI we'd mostly replace anyway). Stack: TanStack Start, TanStack Table, shadcn/ui, Tailwind, zod, Biome. Data access: server functions shelling out to bd --json. V1 scope: projects (epics) view with expandable child issues, issues view with Linear-style grouping/sorting/filtering, side-panel detail with inline edits. Deferred: workspace picker (single project via config), board view, charts.

title: E2E tests for v1 views
description: Playwright e2e: seed a throwaway beads project, boot app, verify issues view grouping/sorting, projects view expand/collapse, side panel open + inline status edit round-trips through bd.
